dataset: PAMIR reproducible PX4 incident benchmark v0.1
policy: Every incident and control in this manifest is a hard CI gate. Sources must be publicly accessible without logs.px4.io. Incident validation requires a material root plus timestamp-ordered downstream telemetry evidence; controls must produce no material failure root.

cases.known_narrative: Indoor offboard takeoff attempt drifted diagonally and slammed into a wall; the reporter also observed rapidly degrading position/attitude estimates.
cases.validation_goal: Surface upstream estimation degradation before downstream vehicle-motion consequences.

cases.known_narrative: After switching an X-Class quadcopter to Follow Me, it climbed rapidly, received a hard yaw/pitch command, lost stability and fell from the sky.
cases.validation_goal: Identify a material upstream telemetry deviation that strictly precedes attitude/motion consequences.

cases.known_narrative: Quadcopter crashed in position mode; the report notes a sudden roll/pitch setpoint jump followed shortly by one motor reaching maximum thrust and velocity-controller oscillation.
cases.validation_goal: Surface a material root before downstream actuation/attitude/motion instability.

cases.known_narrative: A coaxial octocopter that flew normally in Stabilized mode developed sudden vibration after switching to altitude-hold and crashed.
cases.validation_goal: Find a material root that strictly precedes downstream attitude/motion instability.

cases.known_narrative: Hexacopter suddenly dropped from the sky as if power/control stopped; the crash log contains an attitude-control low-stack warning and no normal ground-contact/disarm sequence.
cases.validation_goal: Find a material root before the observed loss-of-flight motion consequence.

cases.known_narrative: Companion public ULog from the same indoor hardware/testing context that did not crash.
cases.validation_goal: Healthy/control flight must produce no material failure root.

cases.known_narrative: Reporter-provided example of the same quadcopter completing a normal 10-20 minute autonomous PX4 mission.
cases.validation_goal: Known successful flight must produce no material failure root.

cases.known_narrative: Reporter-provided normal Stabilized-mode flight from the same coaxial octocopter testing context.
cases.validation_goal: Known normal flight must produce no material failure root.
